verdict.rationale: Mastra Code ships its own tool that lets the agent request access to directories outside the project root, with the user approving or denying each request. This gives a session context beyond a single project directory, but it is an on-demand access grant rather than a documented way to register several project directories in one session. Missing for 10: an explicit multi-directory or workspace setup (flag or config for adding several project roots), details on how added directories are indexed or searched for context, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can include multiple project directories in a single session for broader context

citations.quote: Request access to directories outside the project root. The user is prompted to approve or deny the request.
